messages:
aj (Account Exec): Heads-up — HealthTech just sent a compliance packet. They want SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, 7-year audit log retention, DSAR/ERASURE support for EU users, and the option to run under VPC/private deployment. They need an answer by EOW, sales asking for a concrete scope and rough timeline.

sophie (Support): Uploaded the questionnaire & redacted logs to the shared drive: https://files.redwood/healthtech/qpacket.pdf and https://files.redwood/healthtech/redacted-logs.zip :paperclip:

lisa (PM): Ok — we should map this into the product backlog as a single customer-driven epic and then split into smaller deliverables. Immediate questions: is this purely config work (docs + runbook) or does it require platform changes (retention controls, export tooling, per-customer KMS)? Propose triage = P1 enterprise. :eyes:

ben (Security Eng): Quick notes: 7y retention is unusual and has cost/privacy implications. For SOC2 evidence we can provide configuration screenshots, audit exports, and a runbook, but we'll likely need an uplift to the retention pipeline to guarantee immutable storage for that period. Also need to confirm PHI presence — if PHI, HIPAA adds controls (BAA, HSM/KMS, access logging).

arjun (Infra Eng): From infra side: long retention means more cold storage and retention TTLs in the logging pipeline. We'll need a per-tenant retention override in the Console + billing estimate. Also consider searchable index vs raw blobs — customer likely wants queryable logs for audits.

lisa (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria we can negotiate with the customer: 1) Evidence bundle for SOC2 (config docs + exported logs for requested period) 2) Retention policy configurable per-account up to 7 years, default 90 days 3) DSAR export tool that can produce a user export within 48 hours 4) Option to run on Dedicated or Private deployment for data isolation 5) KMS integration for customer-managed keys (if required). If the ask needs platform changes we mark feature work.

aj (Account Exec): HealthTech says they'll consider Dedicated if it reduces lead time. They want a ballpark cost and timeline quickly. Also they requested that any feature work be scoped before next week so they can update procurement.

ben (Security Eng): Actionable asks for Security: 1) confirm PHI or sensitive categories in the questionnaire 2) provide sample redacted logs (we got those) 3) list required evidence items (they ticked: access logs, change history, key rotation records). I can run a gap analysis once we have the file.

sophie (Support): Sent the redacted logs and highlighted the fields they flagged. Link above.

lisa (PM): Next steps (short): 1) create a single backlog epic with a minimal template and labels: compliance/customer-request, priority:P1, affected-area:retention,kms,dsar 2) attach questionnaire + logs 3) spin up 5d spike (security + infra + PM) to produce an estimate + go/no-go list 4) produce negotiation bullets for sales (what we can deliver in 6 weeks vs requiring a 12+ week feature project).

lisa (PM): Ticket template (use as the epic description):
```
- Customer: HealthTech Co.
- Ask: SOC2 + HIPAA evidence, 7-year audit log retention, DSAR exports, VPC/private option, KMS integration
- Business driver: enterprise procurement / regulated healthcare customer
- Data class: possible PHI (confirm)
- Proposed acceptance criteria:
  * Evidence bundle (config docs + exported logs) for requested window
  * Per-account retention setting up to 7 years
  * DSAR export within 48h
  * Ability to run under Dedicated or Private deployment
  * KMS/customer-managed key option
- Initial triage: spike (5d) -> estimate -> roadmap decision
- Owners: PM:lisa, Security:ben, Infra:arjun
- Attachments: questionnaire.pdf, redacted-logs.zip
```

arjun (Infra Eng): If spike shows infra changes, estimate for the retention feature will include: storage costs, indexing changes, UI for per-tenant TTL, migration plan for existing logs, and tests for immutability. Roughly 3-6 sprint work depending on complexity.

aj (Account Exec): Good. Customer said PO will sign off on Dedicated if it shortens delivery. Also asked about any quick interim mitigations (short-term: export existing logs and hand to them).

ben (Security Eng): Interim mitigation approved: we can produce a one-off manual export for the audit period, but must document process + retention proof. I'll take the spike for security. Need legal for BAA changes if PHI confirmed.

sophie (Support): I'll file the redacted logs and questionnaire into the ticket and notify the customer of the interim export option.

compliance-bot: Created epic C-3421 in product-backlog: https://app.redwood/tickets/C-3421 (labels: compliance/customer-request, priority:P1, area:retention,kms,dsar)

lisa (PM): Assigned C-3421 to ben + arjun for the 5d spike. Meeting to sync TOMORROW 10:00am PT. I'll draft the negotiation bullets for sales after the spike kickoff. :calendar: :thumbsup:

aj (Account Exec): Thanks — I'll let customer know we have an epic and a short spike. Expecting initial estimate within 5 business days. :raised_hands:
